items.title: Clay Jenkins interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, March 18, 2016
items.q: I remember the guy’s name was Michael Convertino. He was the composer. And it was just trumpet.

ctx.x: Can you tell me something that you might hear that you’d go, “oh I was on that.”

Oh I was on a movie called “Bull Durham.” Baseball movie. And it was just me. And it was just in one scene. And I must have played that thing 40 times. I remember the guy’s name was Michael Convertino. He was the composer. And it was just trumpet. That’s all it was. Maybe with synthesizer or something. It was just a kind of a dramatic scene in the locker room. And I’ve made so much money off that thing. And I didn’t play that many. But I just was lucky to get called for it. I mean I’m on some movies and stuff.…
That used to be a hobby of mine with LPs, sort of like, “oh there he is again.”
